lit: without leaving room for a single hair: no gap at all between one thing and the next

story.text: The phrase comes from a Chinese expression meaning 'the gap does not admit a hair'. In a Han-dynasty memorial, the official Mei Cheng warned the King of Wu, who was drifting towards rebellion, that his position was like a huge weight hung by a single thread over a bottomless abyss: the space between safety and ruin was too narrow to fit a hair. Japanese took the phrase over to mean a reaction that follows with no gap at all. Note the reading: kan, hatsu, not kanpatsu.
story.source: Mei Cheng's memorial remonstrating with the King of Wu (Han dynasty China)

bad.en: (meant: she is a lovely, modest, unassuming person)
bad.why: It means people overlook her, which is no compliment. For modesty, say hikaeme de kenkyo na hito.

lit: outside the mosquito net: everyone else is inside together, and you are not

use.how: 蚊帳の外だ, 蚊帳の外に置かれる, 蚊帳の外にされる. Said of someone kept out of information or a decision that concerns them.

near.diff: 影が薄い is simply going unnoticed; 蚊帳の外 is being excluded from what the others know or decide.

cue: The whole family planned the summer trip in a group chat you weren't added to. You only heard about it when the tickets arrived.

ctx.s: 家族旅行[かぞくりょこう]の計画[けいかく]は、僕[ぼく]だけ{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}だった。
ctx.en: Everyone planned the family trip except me; I was kept out of it.

ctx.s: 「え、二人[ふたり]付[つ]き合[あ]ってたの？完全[かんぜん]に{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}じゃん」
ctx.en: "Wait, you two are going out? I've been totally out of the loop!"

ctx.s: 大事[だいじ]な決定[けってい]なのに、現場[げんば]の社員[しゃいん]は{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}に置[お]かれた。
ctx.en: It was a major decision, yet the staff on the ground were left out of it.

ctx.s: サプライズの準備[じゅんび]で、主役[しゅやく]の彼女[かのじょ]はわざと{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}にされていた。
ctx.en: While the surprise was being prepared, she, the guest of honour, was deliberately kept in the dark.

ctx.s: プロジェクトの話[はなし]が進[すす]むなか、私[わたし]はずっと{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}で、メールも届[とど]かなかった。
ctx.en: While the project moved forward, I was left out the whole time and didn't even get the emails.

ctx.s: 自分[じぶん]の進路[しんろ]のことなのに{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}にされるのは納得[なっとく]できない、と彼[かれ]は言[い]った。
ctx.en: He said he couldn't accept being shut out of decisions about his own future.

bad.s: 天気[てんき]がいいので、{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}でお弁当[べんとう]を食[た]べよう。
bad.en: (meant: the weather is nice, so let's eat our lunch outside)
bad.why: It is only figurative, for being left out of the loop, not a way to say outdoors. Say soto de obentou o tabeyou.

bad.s: 不景気[ふけいき]でも、うちの会社[かいしゃ]は{蚊帳[かや]の外[そと]}で影響[えいきょう]がない。
bad.en: (meant: even in the recession our company is unaffected)
bad.why: It means excluded from information or decisions, not immune to trouble. Say eikyou o ukete inai.
